description: This file provides a memberships service module that manages membership plans, current membership state, subscribing, canceling, and related helpers. It supports both backend API calls and localStorage fallback, with mock plans for offline or testing scenarios.

methods.name: detectBackendAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the backend API endpoint for memberships plans is available.

methods.name: readLocalState
methods.description: Reads the membership state from localStorage.

methods.name: writeLocalState
methods.description: Writes the membership state to localStorage.

methods.name: readLocalPlans
methods.description: Retrieves membership plans from localStorage or returns mock plans.

methods.name: normalizeMembershipState
methods.description: Normalizes raw membership data into a consistent object structure.
